description: Waits for every promise; rejects on the first rejection. Values keep input order. Use when every part is required.
Waits for every promise and never rejects; returns `{ status, value | reason }` per input. Use for independent jobs.
Settles like the first promise to settle, success or failure. The classic building block for deadlines.
Fulfills with the first success; rejects with an `AggregateError` only when all reject. Use for redundant sources.
Error with an `errors` array holding every rejection reason, thrown by `Promise.any`.
Starting many concurrent operations from one request. Needs a limit when the list size depends on data or users.
